title: Sneak peek at Foundry Play: host free or paid browser games with built-in chat/voice, CLI uploads, and MCP docs for your agent
author: YouKnowItsMeStudios
selftext:
Just wanted to give everyone an early heads up on what we've been building over the last couple of weeks.

We've been putting the full Foundry platform together and just finished implementing **Foundry Play**, which lets creators host browser games directly on the platform, either for free or as paid releases. We're still doing final polishing, testing, and validation, so this is just an early teaser.

Here's what's already up and running:

1. **In-browser hosting** for web builds (free or paid), with automatic build validation and optimization on upload.
2. **Built-in chat and voice** right alongside the game iframe, so players can talk and play together without leaving the page.
3. **Fast CLI upload flow** via our custom npm package (`@foundry-play/sdk`) so you can validate and push builds straight from your terminal.
4. **SDK, developer docs, and an MCP server**, so your coding agent can read the docs directly, wire up the SDK, and verify your game is properly set up to ship quickly.

Still ironing out the last few rough edges before opening it up wider, but wanted to put it on everyone's radar early. Happy to answer questions or hear what you'd want out of a browser game platform if you're building with AI coding agents.
